title: Missing Accessibility Info
body: The "trend arrow" and all the buttons at the locale profile screen have no accessibility text. This is missing to use talkback.

comments.body:
Thank you for reporting @kevlon300, we should keep our app open for everyone.
We could fix the 2 issues you reported, please contact me through Facebook, slack, or discord to discuss the priority of your needs, if you are able to validate the fix, and if you are willing to help test screenreader accessibility.
